idea-plugin.name: KMP Translations Hub
idea-plugin.description:
Every translation of your Compose Multiplatform app in one table.

  • A Translations tab on every composeResources/values…/strings.xml: all keys of the module against all locales, with missing translations marked.
  • Strings, plurals and string-arrays, with checks for missing translations, mismatched placeholders, plural forms each language needs and array sizes.
  • Edits keep your files' formatting and comments, and each one is a single Undo.
  • ⌘/Ctrl+click Res.string.hello to jump to its XML, and a gutter icon on each key to find the Kotlin code that uses it.
